outcome: Exclusive breastfeeding rates at 1, 3, and 6 months
Use of formula in the hospital
cohort: 954 mother-infant pairs in three communities in Hunan, China
finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with lower rates of exclusive breastfeeding and any breastfeeding, as well as shorter breastfeeding duration.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with a lower rate of exclusive breastfeeding and any breastfeeding compared to vaginal delivery.
